neighbours.label: Forward-pointing preview language in blurbs and introductions (takes us from X to Y, you can watch, stay tuned for, read on for): the text announces what the reader is about to get

predictions: Blurb or intro phrasing that announces upcoming content reaches 0.2-0.6, highest on 'takes us from'; plain narration of past events stays under 0.1.
